entities.summary: George Herbert Walker III was an American businessman, diplomat and philanthropist. Walker served as the United States Ambassador to Hungary from 2003 to 2006. He was a first cousin of President George H. W. Bush as well as first cousin once removed of George W. Bush and Jeb Bush.
